HR screening

Location rule: only Franchise Executives relocate. They work from the Chennai office and must speak the language of the state they handle. Everyone else is matched only to positions in their own district or a neighbouring one (Franchise Manager, State Head and Launch Team: anywhere in the same state; Dispatch, Purchase, Production and Technician at franchise plants: anywhere in the same state).

Age: from date of birth on the resume; ~ = estimated from education years. No age cutoff — 40+ just means check energy in the interview. Salary and joining come from the BDE/BDM application form (L = lakhs a year). For HR-app people the form isn't there, so joining shows whether the resume says they are working now — ask both on the first call.

Unsuitable resumes

Claude read these resumes and found nothing for any open role, so they are not on the dashboard. If you disagree, press Transfer to dashboard, choose the roles to consider them for, and they are matched to positions at the next sync (every 2 hours, or press "Sync leads now"). Every transfer and undo is recorded in the Activity log.
